shared_elements: rectangular slab/panel surface bearing carved decoration
horizontal bands or registers of repeated small elements in the upper zone
a larger motif occupying the field below the banded zone
justification:
The only real correspondence is compositional and generic: both surfaces carry two or three stacked horizontal registers of small repeated elements in the upper area with a larger motif in the field below. What is depicted differs entirely 
inscribed rows of letters plus a symmetrical foliate cross with scrolling tendrils and corner scrolls, executed as fine incised line, versus rows of schematic quadrupeds and other creatures in low relief, so no shared iconographic vocabulary is evident.
